description: This PHP source file appears to be part of a web-based configuration or management interface for network hardware. It includes frontend elements such as HTML and JavaScript, as well as backend PHP code that retrieves and displays network port information, handles user interactions, and performs configuration changes. The code specifically handles LAN Ethernet port status, port enabling/disabling, and special configurations like associating Ethernet port 4 with a home network or security system.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether Ethernet port 4 is enabled for XFINITY Home Security based on network configurations.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly status label for Ethernet port speed and state based on system parameters.
